endorsements.name: Brandon James Roldan
endorsements.label: CVE-2022-0321
endorsements.description: The WP Voting Contest WordPress plugin before 3.0 does not sanitise and escape the post_id parameter before outputting it back in the response via the wpvc_social_share_icons AJAX action (available to both unauthenticated and authenticated users), leading to a Reflected Cross-Site Scripting issue
endorsements.subtitle: CVE

povs-taxonomy.explanation: The CVE endorsement credits this individual with a reviewed vulnerability finding.
